Name: L_Hand
Description: Hand Block with 5 fingers or less (v002: matrix nodes instead of constraints, IK FK per finger, pick the fingers to build, Default or SN orients, auto cups, hand poses)

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Hand Block with 5 fingers or less.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- SetAttrsCtrl: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- CreateFingersAttrs: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4).
- CtrlType: choose one option (for example: circleX, circleY, circleZ, bounding_cube).
- Mirror: choose one option (for example: True, False, Right_Only).
- Orients: Default keeps the Mutant controller orients, SN uses the studio orients (same as the Custom_Biped_Orients block FixFingers, so that block skips this hand).
- FingersIk: adds an IK to every finger (last 3 bones, the IK ctrl sits on the finger tip) and an <Finger>IkFk switch (0 FK, 1 IK) on the attrs ctrl, or on the Wrist ctrl when CreateFingersAttrs is off.
- Thumb / Index / Middle / Ring / Pinky: turning a finger off in the builder deletes its guides, turning it on brings them back where they were (default place the first time). The cups guides stay, they are skipped at build when none of their fingers are built.
- AutoCupPlacement: puts the InnerCup / OutterCup pivots on the palm fold lines (thumb side towards the index knuckle, pinky side between the middle and ring metacarpals), Inner_Cup and OutterCup then cup the palm (positive closes). Done at build, the guides are not moved.
- HandPoses: adds the Fist, Point, Claw and Flat attrs on the attrs ctrl, added on top of the curls (-100 to 100). Off skips them (needs CreateFingersAttrs).
- Controllers scale: finger and cup controllers scale their own joint, the controllers under them do not inherit it.
- Template parent examples: L_Hand_Ankle_Jnt, L_Hand_Palm_Jnt, Spine_End_Jnt.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
